back: The ending of a worker's job because the job is no longer needed; the worker is not at fault.
The ending of employment by the employer because of the worker's conduct or capability.
A dismissal without a valid reason or without the correct procedure; may lead to compensation or reinstatement.
Informal talk, verbal warning, written warning, final written warning, hearing, dismissal, appeal.
Natural wastage, recruitment freeze, retraining and redeployment, shorter hours, job sharing, early retirement.
Voluntary: workers choose to leave, usually for a payment. Compulsory: the employer chooses, using fair criteria.
Short-term payments; savings in wages later; lower morale and trust; the best workers may leave first.
Dismissal without notice for very serious misconduct, which the employer must still be able to prove.
ZIMSEC stresses following the procedure in labour legislation for discipline and dismissal; refer to the law generally.
